description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing category data within a local database, utilizing Android's Room persistence library. It includes methods to retrieve all categories ordered by name and to insert multiple categories with conflict handling.
external_methods: androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY name ASC")

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for accessing category data from a local database using Room ORM. It includes functions to retrieve all categories and insert multiple categories with conflict resolution.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category entities from the database ordered alphabetically by name, returning the results as a Flow stream.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of CategoryEntity objects into the database, ignoring conflicts.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY name ASC")
